description:
The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} serves mocked usage and pricing. To "open the spend popup": navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, then click the VISIBLE ".context-usage-label" element (a hidden one may exist too; pick the visible one). "The popup" is the ".chat-context-popup" element; "the table" is the element inside the popup with role "table" and accessible name "Spend by model". When a step says an element's text "matches" a regular expression, test the regular expression against the element's raw textContent in an eval that has "expect". Perform the steps in order. Unpriced sub-agent usage is not presented as free.
1. Open the spend popup.
2. The table's ".token-cost-model-breakdown" text contains "no pricing".
3. The table's [data-testid="subagent-cost-row"] text contains "no pricing".
4. The popup's text contains "total may be incomplete".
5. The popup's [data-testid="token-cost-total"] is hidden (or absent).
